accounts.name: claimer
docs: Pays rent for claim_receipt. Anyone can call on behalf of a trader.

types.name: BatchReceiptAccount
docs: On-chain audit record for each settled batch. Seeded by [BATCH_SEED, batch_id].

types.name: ClaimReceipt
docs: Nullifier PDA created once per (batch_id, trade_id) to prevent double-claiming.

types.name: TraderAccount
docs: All amounts are in micro-USDT (6 decimals).
`locked_usdt`  = sum of open trade stakes; keeper increments on trade acceptance,
`_reserved2` pads to 65 bytes to match accounts created by the prior layout.
